claim_ceiling: A functional distinction and one bounded real-data outcome only. No general reliability, bibliographic correctness, retrieval-quality, efficiency, cost, or scientific claim is established.
comparison_scope: One offline exact-DOI grouping task on existing Crossref and OpenAlex receipts, with contract comparison against the two single-provider topic search adapters and the known-DOI publication metadata comparator. No same-task accuracy, latency, analyst-time, or cost benchmark was performed.
functional_distinction: This tool consumes already captured provider search receipts, preserves each source summary, and groups exact normalized DOI matches across result sets. Individual search adapters retrieve one provider’s topic results; the existing publication metadata comparator compares selected fields for one known DOI pair.

real_task_observation.interpretation: The ten observed top-ranked rows shared no DOI across these two captured provider snapshots. This does not establish disjoint index coverage, provider precision, recall, relevance, or metadata correctness.

replacement_and_retirement.decision: Keep the provider-specific adapters and known-DOI comparator; allow this specialized offline composition to coexist. Reassess only with additional matched task evidence.
